name: CARV Hindi
description: CARV-Hindi promotes impactful storytelling through theatre and street plays. The club nurtures creativity, teamwork, and public speaking while raising social awareness. Representing RVCE at national competitions, CARV-Hindi has earned accolades at IIT Madras, IIT Bombay, BITS Goa, IIIT Bangalore, and many other national and inter-college events.

events.name: CARV-Hindi Showcase
events.detail: Experience the energy and expression of street play through a glimpse of what CARV Hindi does on stage, followed by fun activities where you can step up, get creative, and showcase your own talents!

events.name: Improv
events.detail: An interactive improv session where you take the stage and create scenes, characters, and stories on the spot. No scripts, no rehearsals, just spontaneity, creativity, and a lot of fun.

events.name: Mad Ads
events.detail: A fun and chaotic activity where you’ll create and perform your own hilarious advertisements on the spot. Think crazy products, catchy slogans, and over-the-top acting.

events.name: Music & Jamming
events.detail: A fun, laid-back singing session where there’s no stage, no pressure, and no rules. Just come together, pick your favourite songs, sing along, and enjoy some music, laughter, and good vibes with everyone.
